summary: Detect apparatus and quotation chunks mechanically at chunk time
description:
Chunks whose content is not the named author's survive nodes 05, 06, 07, 10
and 13, and are first caught by a human/agent reading bodies at node 14. That
is the most expensive possible place to catch them.

## Two kinds, both mechanically detectable

### 1. Apparatus
Translator's notes, editorial introductions, contents enumerations, plate
captions, printer's colophons.

Twelve chunks in the yoga-sutras edge pass, by source:

  Rolt's Dionysius (Divine Names / Mystical Theology)  3
  Hartmann's Boehme (page-keyed endnote blocks)        2
  Heroic Enthusiasts translator's introduction         3   (pt1.010, pt1.011)
  Corpus Hermeticum modern editor's headnote           1
  contents lists / captions / other                    3

Signals available without an LLM:
- density of leading `NNN:N` or bare `NNN ` note markers per paragraph
  (Hartmann's Boehme, Rolt's Dionysius)
- section_label matching Introduction / Preface / Contents
- bracketed editorial voice `<...>` (the Corpus Hermeticum case)
- citation density (Cf., Vide, ibid., Ps. xxiv. 7, Migne)
- first-person editorial ("Note the spiritual sanity of D.")

Worst case, and the clearest cost: dionysius-divine-names-10.003 is Rolt's
commentary on time and eternity (Aevum, Bergson's duree, Von Hugel). On
content it is the BEST partner in the whole corpus for yoga-sutras IV.33's
two-eternities doctrine. It was proposed three times (IV.10, IV.25, IV.33) and
declined three times because it is the translator talking. The real Dionysius
makes the same point one chunk earlier at divine-names-10.002, which was
accepted.

### 2. Quotation chunks — new category, not previously tracked
The chunk is largely another tradition's words quoted under this tradition's
label.

  tertium-organum.156  = Ouspensky quoting Plotinus
                         ("I myself have realized it but three times as yet,
                          and Porphyry hitherto not once")
  tertium-organum.188  = Ouspensky quoting The Voice of the Silence
                         ("The mind is the great slayer of the real")

These attract proposals at several times the normal rate. tertium-156 was the
third-most-proposed partner chunk in the entire pass (10 proposals). The
mechanism is obvious once seen: a chunk containing tradition X's words matches
everything X matches.

An accepted edge from one credits the quoting author with the quoted author's
claim, and mislabels the tradition pair in the Atlas.

Signal: block-quote ratio, plus attribution proximity (a named other author
within N tokens of a long quoted span).

## Suggested placement

Detection at node 06 (chunk) or as a node 07/08 report, NOT as a hard failure
— apparatus chunks stay in the corpus by design. The output wanted is a flag
the downstream nodes can read, so node 10 can skip tagging them and node 13
can skip proposing on them.

Note node 11 already has a hard rule ("scholarly apparatus chunks: always
reject") which the tag pass applies BY HAND. Same defect, same manual cost,
two nodes.
